main_text.p: Gregor. Tu- ron. lib. 3. c. 7.In GALLIA aliquot bella occurrunt, Theodoricus contra Hermenfredum Thuringum, quòd Bertarium fratrem occidiΕllet, a Sigiberto adjutus geffit, & commiffo ad Uoftrutum ... praelio eundem occidit, & Saxon ... partem Thu- ringiæ verfus feptentrionem, ad Hercyniam ... vam, Unltrutum, & Helmarn fluvios, Iradidit ... Alterum Clotharius Theodeberto, Regi Mureni, Theodorici F. movit, quod is à Childeberto ... regni hæres inftitutus fuillet. Hoc cum Iaurii busin Aurelianenfi agro fignis, ludo cælo, ... cum fulminibus & grandine nimbus decidillet interruptum & pace facta, absque fanguinis pro- fufione finitum eft. Tertio Almaricus, de quo Gregor. Tu- ron. lib. 3. c. 32. in Hilpanicis, petitus eft. Quartum Theodo- bertus, Juftiniano in gratiam Gothorum, a re ... Paul. Dia- con. l. 18. ab ilsdem Provincia, in Italia movit, infelici ... Procop. l. 1 de bello Go- thor. ventu. Nam cummeasu defitutus, a ... dyfenteriam maximâ exercitus parte, ... domum redire coactus eft. Eo mortuo, Nan ... Buccelinum, illius Ducem, ad Tanetum ... pania fuperavit. Aminghum, Avidino ... auxilium ferentem, interemit. Leutharium ... Buccelini germanus, dum multa præda ... Franciam reverteretur, juxta lacum ... propriâ morte defunctus eft. Paul. Æmil. Clotharium, Theodibaldi Theodeberti F. ... ditate potentiorem, (hinc fimultates inter Chil- debertum, majorem natu, & Clotharium ... & Thuringos cum Saxonibus rebelles ... In eo Clotharius primò, fufis ad Vitur ... nibus victor; mox c im veniam erroris ... non pollcat, victus & ægré fervatus, ...

page.notes: Scan is a heavily worn, show-through-affected page; many words in the lower half of the text and in the right margin are illegible or only partly readable and are marked here by omission of the uncertain fragments. Several right-margin notes are not legible and have been left out. Ellipses above indicate unreadable stretches that should be treated as [illegible] in a careful pass.
